$description: Tier 1 · App theme: Warpcore (blue-violet 277, live plasma cyan 215). The 28 theme slots, 14 per ground: Figma's `warpcore / graphite` and `warpcore / stone` modes of `Unicron / Theme`, each hex copied exactly from the primitive the role aliases. Emitted in dist/tokens.css as `[data-theme="warpcore"] { --g-theme-… }`. Raw hex only, and only these slots: a change here is a change in Figma first (scripts/figma-parity.mjs holds the two together).
